{{Quote|Many aliens oppose the Empire. Many have brains that do not work like human brains. I attempt to bridge this gap through the science of xenopsychology.|Lodenth Kashar|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Xenopsychology''' was the study of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] minds. [[Lodenth Kashar]] provided xenopsychological analysis and psychological profiling of alien behavior patterns. for [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].
